longDescription.en:
Buzzsprout hosts and distributes podcast episodes to 18+ platforms including Apple Podcasts, Spotify and YouTube, with IAB 2.2 certified analytics, automatic transcripts and Magic Mastering to clean up audio automatically.

The free plan caps uploads at 2 hours/month and hosts episodes for only 90 days. The Audio Podcast plan starts at $15/month (annual billing) for 72 hours/year and unlimited episode retention, with Audio + Video adding video distribution at $25/month. It fits a solo podcaster who wants distribution and analytics handled without extra tools.
longDescription.fr:
Buzzsprout heberge et distribue les episodes de podcast vers plus de 18 plateformes dont Apple Podcasts, Spotify et YouTube, avec une analytique certifiee IAB 2.2, des transcriptions automatiques et Magic Mastering pour nettoyer l'audio automatiquement.

Le plan gratuit plafonne les uploads a 2h/mois et n'heberge les episodes que 90 jours. Le plan Audio Podcast commence a 15 $/mois (facturation annuelle) pour 72 heures/an et une retention d'episodes illimitee, Audio + Video ajoutant la distribution video a 25 $/mois. Il convient a un podcasteur solo qui veut la distribution et l'analytique geres sans outils supplementaires.
